content: Merikɨtsɨ, te'aitamete waɨkawa mekaniutimamani 'amuxeutsixi Kurutani 'anataɨye tau makayuyuipike hepatsie memɨtamakai, meta kananeutsixi haramara Meritexaniyu tetsita memɨtamakai, kepauka memɨtehetima kename Yawé Kurutani hekawatsiɨxaxɨ mana memukɨnekɨ 'ixaheritsixi. Mepɨkayuwaɨriyakai memɨwatakwinikɨ.
'Ana tukaritsie, Yawé Kutsuhexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Tete nawaxayari keneutiwewi, xitekiya 'inɨariyari tawarita keneutsutɨa 'ixaheritsixi wahetsie».
Hikɨ Kutsuhexi tete nawaxayari kaniutiwewieni, 'ixaheritsixi xitekiya 'inɨariyari kaniwaruwewirieni 'Araruti yemuriyaritsie.
'Inɨari xitekiyari pɨwaruwewiri 'ixaheritsixi 'Ekipitu memeyekɨnekai kuyakɨ me'aye'atɨarietɨkaitɨ makumawetsie me'uhutɨ memukwikaikɨri.
Mɨkɨ yunaitɨ xitekiya mepexeiyakai, peru me'ayekɨneka 'Ekipitu makumawetsie me'uhukaku memutinunuiwaxɨ mɨkɨ xitekiya mepɨkahexeiyakai.

Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ pɨtiwarahɨawekai watutsima kwie pɨwayetuirienikekai retsi meta xiete maxuawe. Peru 'ixaheritsixi 'Ekipitu memɨyekɨ Yawé mepɨka'anu'eni, 'ayumieme puyuhɨritɨa mɨkawapitɨanikɨ memixeiyakɨ mɨkɨ kwie. 'Ayumieme makumawetsie mepu'uwakai huta tewiyari wiyari, me'ukwikuke yunaitɨ 'ukitsi kuyakɨ memaye'atɨarietɨkatei.
Mɨkɨ waniwema, Kakaɨyari mɨwarupitɨa wahetsiemieme, Kutsuhexi xitekiya 'inɨariyari kaniwaruwewirieni, 'inɨari memɨka'uwewiyariekɨ me'uhutɨ.

Hikɨ Yawé Kutsuhexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «'Ari nepɨxe'uxɨnaxɨ kexemɨteyutetewiyakai waɨriyarika te'uximayatamete xehɨkɨtɨtɨ 'Ekipitu». 'Ayumieme mana Kirikari mepɨte'uterɨwaxɨ, hikɨ 'akuxi mɨpaɨ pɨrakutewa.
Mexɨakame metseritsie tamamata heimana nauka taikaiyaritsie, makuweritsie metitetɨ Keriku 'aurie, 'ixaheritsixi Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyari mekaniuwewieni.
'Uxa'arieka heutipareku 'ixɨarari, teɨteri mekateniutikwani naime kwiepa timieme, paa mɨkakuxanariyarietɨka meta tɨriku xarikiyari.
kawiwiwetɨ katiniuhayewa, mɨkɨ wiyaritsie 'ixaheritsixi 'ikwaxi mekatenikwakaitɨni kwiepa timieme.

Merikɨtsɨ Kutsuhexi Keriku 'aurie kaniukateitɨni, kepauka manukunierixɨ xeime tewi kaniuxeiya hɨxiena 'uweme, 'ixipara heukwekame. Kutsuhexi 'ahurawa kaniuyani kanita'iwawiya: ―¿'Ekɨ petihɨkɨ tahetsɨamieme, nutsutɨ pemɨtatsi'aye'unie pepɨyɨane?

Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Nixeime hetsɨa nepɨkamieme. Nepɨnehekɨata 'ahɨxie kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame nehɨkɨtɨtɨ Yawé hetsɨamieme. Hikɨ Kutsuhexi kaniukahɨximakeni kwiepa mɨpaɨta katinita'iwawiya: ―¿Tita penetiku'aitɨane neti'aitɨwame? Mati'uximayatsiriwame nepɨhɨkɨ.
Kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame Yawé hetsɨamieme mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―'Akakai kenanuyehɨnaxɨa, pemanuwetsie kanakupatsieka. Kutsuhexi mɨpaɨ katinikayani.
